title: Show active CSV rerun child item
summary: Status snapshots now follow active CSV rerun child runtime progress so Home can identify the file currently being encoded.
reason: CSV rerun jobs launch nested pipeline runtime state under the rerun workspace; the parent progress file can remain idle or stale while the child pipeline is actively encoding.
behavior_before: Home and worker telemetry read the parent pipeline progress and ActiveJobs log tail for CSV reruns, so an active encode could render the current item as None.
behavior_after: When an active rerun_csv ActiveJobs record has matching child pipeline_progress.json evidence, status snapshots and worker telemetry use that child current item, stage, and percent.
manual_validation: python -m ruff check touched status/test files - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the rerun child-progress overlay module plus the snapshot_runner, active_jobs, and focused test changes to restore parent-only status rendering.
notes:
Read active CSV rerun child progress so status snapshots can identify the current encoded item.
Overlay active CSV rerun child progress before building current activity and status summary.
Allow worker telemetry to merge rerun child progress when it matches the parent ActiveJobs launch id.
Cover snapshot fallback from parent CSV rerun ActiveJobs record to child runtime progress with current item.
Cover CSV rerun worker telemetry merging child progress into determinate active item rows.
Read-only observability change; no queue, process-control, or media-file mutation behavior changed.
Generated summary for the new rerun progress status helper.
Refreshed summary for snapshot runner's rerun progress import.
